title: 3rd Stopping Place 4th Truth The Provision Of Subtle Faculties And The Wisdom Of Provision

questions.question: Who created the universe and also created life as a summary of it?
questions.answer: Allah, the All-Powerful and Wise One.

questions.question: What does the passage say was gathered into life from the whole universe?
questions.answer: Many of Allah’s purposes and signs of His Names were brought together in life.

questions.question: Why was provision made an important center within living things?
questions.answer: So living beings would seek food and, through that, show thanks, gratitude, and worship to Allah.

questions.question: What feeling inside living creatures helps move them toward their provision?
questions.answer: Their desire and taste for food.

questions.question: According to the passage, what are people and animals saved from when they go after provision?
questions.answer: They are kept from laziness and idleness.

questions.question: Which parts of creation are mentioned as being filled with joy in different ways?
questions.answer: The heavens, the unseen world, and the physical world, especially the air and the earth.

questions.question: Which creatures are especially mentioned in the air and on the earth?
questions.answer: Birds, both large and small, and other living beings.

questions.question: What does the passage suggest would happen if these wise purposes did not exist?
questions.answer: Food would come to animals directly without effort, like provision comes to a tree.

questions.question: What kind of eye does the passage imagine?
questions.answer: An eye that could see and understand the whole earth at once.

questions.question: What two Divine Names would that eye notice through the giving of provision?
questions.answer: The Names showing Allah’s mercy and His providing.

questions.question: When is the help to animals especially described?
questions.answer: At the end of winter, when their food is running low.

questions.question: Where are these gifts of food placed for animals?
questions.answer: In plants, on trees, and in mothers’ milk.

questions.question: What do these foods show about their source?
questions.answer: They come from Allah’s unseen mercy and generosity.

questions.question: What main lesson does the whole passage teach about provision?
questions.answer: Allah wisely gives provision and uses it to lead living beings toward thankfulness and worship.

questions.question: How is life described in relation to the whole universe?
questions.answer: It is described as a small but complete summary of the universe.

questions.question: What was placed inside living beings so they would care about provision?
questions.answer: A taste and need for it.

questions.question: What response to Allah is connected to seeking provision?
questions.answer: Ongoing thankfulness, gratitude, and worship.

questions.question: Why does the passage call this one of the important wisdoms in creation?
questions.answer: Because provision is not only for survival; it also helps creatures turn to Allah in thankfulness.

questions.question: What groups are mentioned as bringing joy to different parts of creation?
questions.answer: Angels and spirit beings in the heavens, spirits in the unseen world, and living creatures in the material world.

questions.question: Why are animals and humans pushed to seek food?
questions.answer: Because they feel need and also find enjoyment in it.

questions.question: What is one good result of this push toward food?
questions.answer: It gets them moving and keeps them from being inactive.

questions.question: What comparison is made between animals and trees?
questions.answer: Trees stay where they are and their provision comes to them, but animals usually go after theirs.

questions.question: If animals received provision the same way trees do, what would be different?
questions.answer: They would not need to make effort to get their food.

questions.question: What season is used as an example of Allah’s care?
questions.answer: The end of winter.

questions.question: Why is that season important in the example?
questions.answer: Because animals’ stored food is nearly gone then.

questions.question: How are the foods sent at that time described?
questions.answer: They are tasty, plentiful, and varied.

questions.question: What can a person understand by thinking deeply about these examples?
questions.answer: That Allah alone sends merciful help to living creatures in a wise and caring way.

questions.question: What two qualities of Allah are highlighted at the start of the passage?
questions.answer: His perfect power and His wisdom.

questions.question: What does it mean that life is a summary of the universe in this passage?
questions.answer: It means life gathers many meanings and purposes of creation into one place.

questions.question: What was made central in the world of living things?
questions.answer: Provision and sustenance.

questions.question: What does the search for food lead living beings to do spiritually?
questions.answer: To give thanks and worship Allah.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the thankfulness connected to provision?
questions.answer: It is constant and found everywhere among living beings.

questions.question: Name one example the passage gives of Allah making creation joyful.
questions.answer: The heavens are filled with joy through angels and spirit beings.

questions.question: What two things urge humans and animals to look for provision?
questions.answer: Their need for it and the pleasure they feel in it.

questions.question: What bad condition are they rescued from by this system?
questions.answer: Being lazy and inactive.

questions.question: What does the example of the tree help the reader understand?
questions.answer: It shows that Allah could send food without effort if He willed, but He made wisdom in creatures seeking it.

questions.question: What would an all-seeing eye witness on the earth?
questions.answer: The beauty of Allah’s mercy and His giving of provision.

questions.question: In the example near the end, who receives special care when food is almost finished?
questions.answer: Groups of animals.

questions.question: What does the arrival of food after winter teach about Allah?
questions.answer: That He helps His creatures from His unseen mercy with care and generosity.

questions.question: According to the passage, who made life and gave it a very important place in creation?
questions.answer: Allah did.

questions.question: What was put into life along with many Divine purposes?
questions.answer: Signs of Allah’s Names.

questions.question: What is the purpose of making provision a major focus among living beings?
questions.answer: To connect their need for food with gratitude and worship.

questions.question: How do living creatures answer Allah’s care for them, according to the passage?
questions.answer: They answer with thankfulness and worship.

questions.question: What broad activity of Allah is described with examples from the heavens, unseen world, and earth?
questions.answer: His making different parts of creation lively and joyful.

questions.question: Who are mentioned in the heavens?
questions.answer: Angels and spirit beings.

questions.question: What fills the material world especially, according to the passage?
questions.answer: Many living things, especially birds.

questions.question: How does the need for provision affect people and animals?
questions.answer: It drives them to seek what they need.

questions.question: Why is pleasure in food also important in the passage?
questions.answer: It encourages creatures to pursue their sustenance.

questions.question: What problem would happen without this wise arrangement?
questions.answer: Creatures would tend toward idleness.

questions.question: What special comparison shows another way Allah could have fed animals?
questions.answer: Their food could have been sent to them directly like the food of trees.

questions.question: What kind of person could fully notice the beauty of this system?
questions.answer: Someone with an eye able to see and understand the whole earth at once.

questions.question: What time of year shows Allah’s care very clearly?
questions.answer: The end of winter.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the source of the foods then given?
questions.answer: They come from Allah’s hidden treasure of mercy and generosity.

questions.question: What does the passage teach about the relationship between the universe and life?
questions.answer: Life was made to gather and reflect the meanings of the universe.

questions.question: What was centered within life to serve an important purpose?
questions.answer: Provision.

questions.question: What was placed in living things so they would seek provision?
questions.answer: An appetite and liking for it.

questions.question: Besides eating, what higher result comes from seeking provision?
questions.answer: Creatures show gratitude and worship to Allah.

questions.question: Why does the passage mention angels, spirits, animals, and birds together?
questions.answer: To show that many parts of creation are included in Allah’s lively and joyful ordering.

questions.question: Which two human experiences help move creatures toward food?
questions.answer: Need and enjoyment.

questions.question: What effect does this have on daily life?
questions.answer: It makes creatures active in searching for sustenance.

questions.question: What weakness is avoided by this activity?
questions.answer: Laziness.

questions.question: How does the example of the tree strengthen the passage’s message?
questions.answer: It shows Allah has the power to send food without effort, but He chose a wiser way for animals and people.

questions.question: What imaginary ability would help someone see this wisdom everywhere on earth?
questions.answer: Being able to view the whole earth at the same time.

questions.question: Which Divine qualities would become clear through that view?
questions.answer: Allah’s mercy and His providing.

questions.question: What happens for animals when winter is ending and food is nearly gone?
questions.answer: Rich and pleasant food is sent to help them.

questions.question: What is a good main idea for this passage?
questions.answer: Allah gives provision with wisdom, mercy, and care, and this leads creatures toward thankfulness.

questions.question: Who is described as creating both the universe and life?
questions.answer: Allah, the One full of power and wisdom.

questions.question: How is life described after the universe is mentioned?
questions.answer: As a complete summary containing the meanings of the universe.

questions.question: What was gathered into life from Allah’s works?
questions.answer: His aims in creation and signs of His Beautiful Names.

questions.question: What was made a main point of activity inside living beings?
questions.answer: Provision.

questions.question: Why were living things given a desire for provision?
questions.answer: So they would seek it and respond with gratitude and worship.

questions.question: What kind of worship is connected to this response?
questions.answer: Ongoing and widespread worship through thankfulness.

questions.question: What examples show that different worlds are made joyful?
questions.answer: The heavens with angels, the unseen world with spirits, and the earth and air with living creatures.

questions.question: Which creatures are specially named to show the liveliness of the world?
questions.answer: Birds of all sizes.

questions.question: What pushes animals and people to go after sustenance?
questions.answer: Their hunger and the enjoyment they find in eating.

questions.question: What benefit comes from their effort to seek food?
questions.answer: They are protected from becoming idle.

questions.question: What does the passage say would happen if this wisdom were not intended?
questions.answer: Food would simply come to animals on its own without their trying for it.

questions.question: What example from nature is used to explain that easier way?
questions.answer: The way provision comes to a tree.

questions.question: What scene on earth would show the beauty of Allah’s care most clearly?
questions.answer: Animals receiving many kinds of food at the end of winter when they are in need.

questions.question: What final truth would a person learn from seeing that scene?
questions.answer: Allah alone sends timely help from His unseen mercy in a tender and generous way.
